newsitem.title: USA: Barnes Group sees record 1997, good Q1 start.
newsitem.headline: Barnes Group sees record 1997, good Q1 start.

text.p: Barnes Group Inc said Wednesday that results for the first quarter and fiscal 1997 are positive so far.

"From the looks of the first quarter, we're off to another good start and we expect 1997 to be another record year for the company," the company said in a release. "Our goal is to be a top-tier performer for the long term."
Barnes shares were off 1/2 Wednesday at 71.

Barnes Group Inc is a diversified international company based in Bristol, Connecticut. It makes precision springs and complex metal components for industrial, transportation and aerospace markets and distributes repair and replacement products to the maintenance, repair and operating supplies market.
